title: Open Private Cloud for Supernote
description: Operational overview for Open Private Cloud for Supernote (.note processing pipeline, AI token usage, HTTP/MCP health, and blob storage).

panels.title: Processor Queue State
panels.description: Whether background .note pipeline execution is active (0) or paused by an admin (1).

panels.title: Queued Notebooks
panels.description: Number of .note files waiting in the background processor queue.

panels.title: .note Runs Succeeded
panels.description: Completed .note processing pipeline runs across the selected time window.

panels.title: Failed Pipeline Tasks
panels.description: Failed background pipeline module task attempts across the selected time window.

panels.title: AI Tokens Consumed
panels.description: Total billed AI tokens (input + output + thinking) processed across the selected time window.

panels.title: Available Storage Space
panels.description: Free space remaining on the blob storage volume (red < 1 GiB alert threshold, yellow < 5 GiB).

panels.title: Processor Queue Backlog
panels.description: Number of .note files waiting in the background processor queue.

panels.title: .note Pipeline Run Outcomes
panels.description: Completed, failed, and cancelled .note pipeline runs per interval by execution mode (full vs on_demand).

panels.title: Pipeline Stage Executions & Failures
panels.description: Per-module task attempts that executed work (success vs failure), excluding unchanged checkpoint skips.

panels.title: Pipeline Run & Stage p95 Duration
panels.description: 95th percentile execution latency for end-to-end .note runs and individual processor modules during active windows.

panels.title: .note Pages Reconciled by Change Type
panels.description: Pages reconciled during PageHashingModule (added, modified, moved, unchanged, deleted).

panels.title: Checkpoint Skips & Task Recoveries
panels.description: Completed module tasks skipped via incremental checkpoints alongside stalled or missing file recoveries.

panels.title: AI Invocations by Stage & Outcome
panels.description: Logical AI model calls across ocr, summary, embedding_doc, and embedding_query (live search).

panels.title: AI Tokens Consumed by Stage & Type
panels.description: Disjoint token counts (input, output, thinking) processed per interval across AI stages.

panels.title: AI Model p95 Latency & Failure Ratio
panels.description: Left axis: p95 AI call latency in seconds. Right axis: AI failure percentage.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, provider, model, stage) (rate(supernote_ai_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]))) >= 0

sum by (provider, stage) (rate(supernote_ai_requests_total{job=~"$job", status="failure"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (provider, stage) (rate(supernote_ai_requests_total{job=~"$job", status!="cancelled"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: HTTP Request Rate by Status Class
panels.description: Request throughput grouped by status family (499 represents client-cancelled connections).

panels.title: HTTP Slowest Routes (p95 Latency)
panels.description: Top 5 active HTTP route patterns ranked by p95 latency (idle routes excluded).

targets.expr: topk(5, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, path) (rate(supernote_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]))) >= 0)

panels.title: MCP Tool Calls & p95 Latency
panels.description: Left axis: MCP tool invocations (bars). Right axis: MCP p95 latency in seconds.

panels.title: HTTP 5xx & Database Session Errors
panels.description: Discrete HTTP 5xx server error responses and SQLAlchemy database session errors per interval.

panels.title: .note Uploads by Source
panels.description: Completed .note file uploads per interval originating from Supernote device sync versus Web UI.

panels.title: OSS Transfer Throughput
panels.description: Object storage upload and download throughput across user blobs, multipart chunks, PNG previews, and PDF exports.

panels.title: Stored Blob Size by Kind
panels.description: Total bytes stored across user blobs and cached PNG/PDF artifacts (refreshed every 5 minutes).

panels.title: Stored Blob Objects by Kind
panels.description: Object count stored across user blobs and cached PNG/PDF artifacts (refreshed every 5 minutes).
